msec.server_trust.trust.title: MSec Server Identity Trust
msec.server_trust.trust.paragraph_1: You are connecting to this server for the first time. In order to secure your connection, please verify the fingerprint below:
msec.server_trust.trust.paragraph_2: Ask the server owner for the fingerprint and compare. If it matches exactly, click [Trust This Server] to resume connecting. Otherwise, click [Disconnect] immediately! Once trusted, this interface won't show up again.
msec.server_trust.trust.paragraph_3: Additionally, this fingerprint also belongs to the following known servers:
msec.server_trust.update.title: MSec Server Identity Update
msec.server_trust.update.paragraph_1: The fingerprint of this server has changed from this known value:
msec.server_trust.update.paragraph_3: This can be caused by a server re-deployment, or possibly attacks. Please confirm this matter with the server owner and ask for the new fingerprint. Click [Trust New Fingerprint] only if the the owner explicitly says you can do so. Once trusted, the new fingerprint will override the old one.
msec.server_trust.common.hint: You can paste the fingerprint from the owner to verify below.
